title: Identifying Possible Crater from Gaza Hospital Blast
used_for: Early, geolocated identification of the impact point, crater, parking-lot damage, and nearby area occupied by people; also records the limits of inferring munition type from the crater alone.
quality_notes: Transparent professional OSINT based on public imagery and geolocation. Preliminary, without site access, and partly dependent on the same visual corpus used by other investigations; excluded from the research bibliography and stored as journalistic analysis evidence.
citation_text: Bellingcat Investigation Team. (2023, October 18). Identifying possible crater from Gaza hospital blast. Bellingcat. https://www.bellingcat.com/news/2023/10/18/identifying-possible-crater-from-gaza-hospital-blast/

title: Explosion at Al-Ahli Hospital in Gaza: New findings from our investigation
authors_or_organization: Arthur Carpentier, Thomas Eydoux, Le Monde video investigation team, and Félix Pommier
used_for: CASE-001 visual timeline, crater size, Gaza rocket-barrage compatibility, rejection of the widely cited Al Jazeera projectile as causal, and explicit inability to establish cause with certainty.
quality_notes: Named newsroom visual investigation with disclosed calculations and expert consultation. No site access; it shares much of the same public video corpus as AP, HRW, and other investigations and is journalistic supporting evidence.
citation_text: Carpentier, A., Eydoux, T., Le Monde video investigation team, & Pommier, F. (2023, November 3). Explosion at Al-Ahli Hospital in Gaza: New findings from our investigation. Le Monde. https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/11/03/explosion-at-al-ahli-hospital-in-gaza-new-findings-from-our-investigation_6224647_4.html

title: New AP analysis of last month's deadly Gaza hospital explosion rules out widely cited video
used_for: CASE-001 updated visual assessment: rejects a key initially cited video, retains a Gaza-launched rocket as the most likely scenario, documents modest structural damage, and states the absence of definitive ground forensics.
quality_notes: Named updated newsroom investigation that transparently corrects a key evidentiary link. It has no site access and shares public imagery with other analyses; stored as journalistic supporting evidence.
citation_text: Biesecker, M. (2023, November 22). New AP analysis of last month's deadly Gaza hospital explosion rules out widely cited video. Associated Press. https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-hospital-rocket-gaza-e0fa550faa4678f024797b72132452e3

title: Live updates: U.S. intelligence estimates 100 to 300 died in hospital blast
used_for: Documents that an unclassified U.S. intelligence assessment reported by 19 October placed deaths at the low end of a 100–300 range and said the estimate could evolve; used as an attributed estimate, not as a verified casualty count.
quality_notes: Reputable wire report describing an assessment delivered to Congress, but the underlying assessment is not linked as a public primary document and the estimate was expressly preliminary; stored as journalistic evidence.
citation_text: Associated Press. (2023, October 19). Live updates: U.S. intelligence estimates 100 to 300 died in hospital blast. https://apnews.com/article/1f06a2c07957bfdd5330d32cb211809d

title: After blast kills hundreds at Gaza hospital, Hamas and Israel trade blame as rage spreads in region
authors_or_organization: Najib Jobain, Samya Kullab, Ravi Nessman, and Matthew Lee / Associated Press
used_for: Documents the initial public casualty and Israeli-airstrike attribution reported by Gaza authorities and the competing Israeli denial during the first reporting phase; used only as an attributed-claim timeline.
quality_notes: Reputable breaking-news report useful for what claims were public at the time, not for verifying the casualty total or causal attribution in a rapidly changing event; stored as journalistic evidence.
citation_text: Jobain, N., Kullab, S., Nessman, R., & Lee, M. (2023, October 17). After blast kills hundreds at Gaza hospital, Hamas and Israel trade blame as rage spreads in region. Associated Press. https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-hamas-war-biden-rafah-e062825a375d9eb62e95509cab95b80c

title: French intelligence points to Palestinian rocket, not Israeli airstrike, for Gaza hospital blast
used_for: Documents the French military-intelligence briefing, the Gaza Health Ministry's revision from 500 to 471, competing on-scene estimates, and the limits acknowledged by the French official.
quality_notes: Reputable wire report of an authorized but anonymous French intelligence briefing; the underlying classified material is unavailable and the official explicitly stated a lack of certainty; stored as journalistic evidence.
citation_text: Vaux-Montagny, N. (2023, October 20). French intelligence points to Palestinian rocket, not Israeli airstrike, for Gaza hospital blast. Associated Press. https://apnews.com/article/7be0d59b9ceb58bbf2f03c5dc8222356

title: U.S. details intelligence it says clears Israel in Gaza hospital blast
used_for: Documents the U.S. confidence distinctions and that at least one communication used in the U.S. assessment was supplied by Israel, preventing the assessment from being described as based solely on independent evidence.
quality_notes: Detailed national-security reporting based on unnamed U.S. officials. Useful for public methodological limits, but not a substitute for the unavailable underlying intelligence assessment; stored as journalistic evidence.
citation_text: Harris, S. (2023, October 24). U.S. details intelligence it says clears Israel in Gaza hospital blast. The Washington Post. https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2023/10/24/al-ahli-hospital-us-intelligence/

title: Human rights investigators raise new questions on Gaza hospital explosion
used_for: Documents the early Forensic Architecture, Earshot, and Al-Haq challenges to the direction analysis and to the credibility/provenance of the IDF-released intercepted audio.
quality_notes: Verified broadcaster report presenting named specialist groups' preliminary challenges. The underlying analyses were early, shared public evidence with other inquiries, and did not conclusively identify the perpetrator; stored as journalistic evidence.
citation_text: Channel 4 News. (2023, October 21). Human rights investigators raise new questions on Gaza hospital explosion [Video]. YouTube. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MVQALHmgo8U

title: Hezbollah confirms its leader Hassan Nasrallah was killed in an Israeli airstrike
used_for: Independent contemporaneous transmission of Hezbollah's 28 September confirmation and the IDF's self-attribution; used only to establish the existence and timing of the public confirmation.
quality_notes: High-quality wire report quoting the party statement. It is not the original Hezbollah publication and does not independently establish every military or legal claim. This article is not part of the 27-item CASE-003 analysis basket.
citation_text: Associated Press. (2024, September 28). Hezbollah confirms its leader Hassan Nasrallah was killed in an Israeli airstrike. https://apnews.com/article/c4751957433ff944c4eb06027885a973

title: The Latest: World leaders call on Iran and Israel to avoid allowing conflict to worsen
used_for: Documents the public evidentiary state on 19 April: an apparent Israeli strike near Isfahan, no Israeli acknowledgement, Iranian non-acknowledgement of Israeli responsibility, and the IAEA's contemporaneous statement that the Isfahan nuclear facility was undamaged.
quality_notes: High-quality contemporaneous wire report useful for the public claim timeline and explicit uncertainty. Attribution to Israel depended on unnamed U.S. officials and was not officially acknowledged by Israel within the sampled window; it is therefore not treated as conclusive public proof of mechanism or weapon type.
citation_text: Associated Press. (2024, April 19). The Latest: World leaders call on Iran and Israel to avoid allowing conflict to worsen. https://apnews.com/article/554e36a603a12f448f5cfa80c5c30bd6

title: Israeli military confirms Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar is dead
used_for: Documents the progression on 17 October from preliminary reports that Sinwar was very likely dead to Israel's official confirmation, without converting the earlier probability into certainty before confirmation.
quality_notes: Reuters contemporaneous reporting carried on a public syndication page. Useful for the public chronology and attributed official statements; it is not the underlying forensic record and is independent journalism rather than an official primary source.
citation_text: Reuters. (2024, October 17). Israeli military confirms Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar is dead. Investing.com. https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/israeli-ministers-are-told-sinwar-very-likely-dead-two-officials-say-3669168

title: Trapped by Israeli troops, Sinwar threw stick at drone before death, video shows
used_for: Documents Israel's reported use of dental records, fingerprints and DNA to identify the body; reports the released drone footage as Israeli-provided evidence; and records Hamas's 18 October confirmation.
quality_notes: Reuters synthesis based partly on Israeli official and military material and Hamas's public confirmation. Identification methods and the footage's interpretation remain attributed reporting rather than direct access to forensic files.
citation_text: Reuters. (2024, October 18). Trapped by Israeli troops, Sinwar threw stick at drone before death, video shows. Investing.com. https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/sinwars-death-came-at-the-end-of-months-of-searching-by-israel-3669956

title: Hamas likely to name new leader from outside Gaza after Sinwar's death
used_for: Documents that the permanent succession remained unsettled on 18 October and distinguishes temporary operational leadership in Gaza from a definitive appointment as the organization's overall leader.
quality_notes: Forward-looking contemporaneous wire analysis based on named and unnamed sources. Suitable for bounding uncertainty, not for proving who ultimately succeeded Sinwar after the sampled window.
citation_text: Reuters. (2024, October 18). Hamas likely to name new leader from outside Gaza after Sinwar's death. Investing.com. https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/hamas-likely-to-name-new-leader-from-outside-gaza-after-sinwars-death-3671411
